name: High School Summer Internship (Georgia Tech Research Institute)
city: Atlanta, GA; Cobb County; Warner Robins, GA (in person)
what_you_do: Five week paid, in person internship at a Georgia Tech Research Institute site. Interns work up to 24 hours a week on STEM projects with GTRI staff.
who_can_apply: Georgia residents in a public, private, charter or home school in Georgia, in the class of 2027, 2028 or 2029, who are 16 by April 4, 2027 (no exceptions). Proof of U.S. citizenship or U.S. person status is required for most positions. You need your own transportation.
pay_detail: Described as a paid internship. The pay rate is not on the page.
duration: Five weeks, about June 14 to July 23, 2027; up to 24 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
deadline_text: Pre-application launch is planned for December 11, 2026. The closing date is not listed on the page. The page says dates are approximate and final dates will be in the pre-application.
how_to_apply: Complete the online pre-application. It has a resume (PDF), a personal statement and a letter of recommendation. It must be 100% complete before it closes. You can join the 2027 contact registry for updates. Email support.hsi.stem@gtri.gatech.edu with questions.
notes: No weekend, after hours or remote work. Housing is not provided. Do not send unsolicited emails or calls to GTRI employees about internships. The page asks this. Finishing the pre-application does not guarantee a job. Georgia Department of Labor says a work permit is required only for minors who have not reached their 16th birthday. This internship requires age 16 by April 4, 2027.
